$comment: Log call sites scripts/check-log-redaction.mjs found on 2026-09-20, each in a file this lane may not edit. Every entry names why the field is wrong today and the exact change that removes it. The guard refuses a new one and refuses an entry that no longer occurs, so this list only shrinks.

known.reason: the webhook signature header is logged whole when verification fails; it is a credential, so the redactor replaces it and the line says only that something failed
known.fix: replace { signature } with { signaturePresent: Boolean(signature), deliveryId } so the line separates a missing header from a wrong one

known.reason: the provider's error body can carry the transcript it refused, so redaction is right and the field is dead weight
known.fix: replace { body: responseText } with { bodyBytes: responseText.length, providerErrorCode } read from the parsed provider error

known.reason: the name contains "credential" so the count of connectors described without credentials is redacted at startup, which is the one number that line exists to report
known.fix: rename to describedWithoutCredentialCount, or to uncredentialedConnectors

known.reason: the rate limit bucket key embeds a caller identifier, so redacting it is right; identifier is already logged beside it on the lines that need it
known.fix: delete the key field from the six log calls; where the bucket matters, log policyName instead

known.reason: a failed backup deletion during an erasure leaves a copy of erased data, and the only field naming the copy is a bare key, which the redactor throws away
known.fix: rename to objectKey, which the field policy classifies as an identifier

known.reason: the embedding provider's error body can echo the text it was given, so redaction is right and the field is dead weight
known.fix: replace { body: body.slice(0, 500) } with { bodyBytes: body.length } and the provider's error code

known.reason: the line that says an incident alert reached no human names the alert with a bare key, which the redactor throws away
known.fix: rename to notificationKey, which the field policy classifies as an identifier

known.reason: the object that exceeded the copy limit is named by a bare key, so the operator cannot find it
the operator notification token is logged whole when the alert is undeliverable; it is a credential, so the redactor replaces it
known.fix: replace token: target.token with tokenConfigured: Boolean(target.token); kind and reference already say which target failed

known.reason: the alert dedup key is a bare key, so the line that says paging went ahead without dedup cannot say which alert
known.fix: rename to dedupeKey, which the field policy classifies as an identifier

known.reason: the name contains credential, so the list of providers that rejected their credential is redacted on both failover lines
the live voice provider error body can echo the instructions it refused, so redaction is right and the field is dead weight
known.fix: replace body: responseText with bodyBytes: responseText.length; upstreamCode is already on the line

known.reason: the malformed contract metadata line names the offending field with a bare key, so an operator cannot tell which metadata value is wrong
the free lane route health key is a bare key, so the line that says health was not recorded cannot say for which route
known.fix: rename to cacheKey, which the field policy classifies as an identifier

known.reason: the provider identifier is named providerKey, which reads as a provider credential, so the degraded mark and read failures name no provider
known.fix: rename to providerId, the vocabulary the rest of the routing code uses
